blocks.text: Exercise mein das multiple choice, aath short aur aath long sawal hain (long sawal 7 kitab mein number ke baghair chhapa hai). Har sawal ka hal us ke topic ke Roman Urdu lesson mein self-check ki shakal mein hai; neeche har sawal ke saath us ka topic likha hai.

1. Python mein list ke aakhir mein item jorne ke liye kaunsa function hai?
a) insert()
b) append()
c) remove()
d) pop()

2. Python list ke saath 'in' keyword kya karta hai?
a) list mein item jorta hai
b) list se item nikalta hai
c) check karta hai ke item list mein hai ya nahi
d) list ki lambai batata hai

3. Stack ke top se item kaunsa operation nikalta hai?
a) Push
b) Pop
c) Peek
d) Add

4. Infix ko postfix mein badalte waqt stack kis cheez ko sambhalne mein madad deta hai?
a) operands ki tarteeb
b) operators ki priority
c) parentheses (brackets)
d) b aur c dono

5. Queue mein item jorne ke liye kaunsa operation hai?
a) Dequeue
b) Peek
c) Enqueue
d) Remove

6. Tree par BFS mein level ba level nodes dekhne ke liye queue ka kaunsa operation istemal hota hai?
a) stack ke aakhir mein nodes jorna
b) list ke aakhir se nodes nikalna
c) queue mein nodes enqueue karna
d) stack se nodes dequeue karna

7. Kaunsa tree traversal root node ko us ke children se pehle dekhta hai?
a) In-order
b) Pre-order
c) Post-order
d) Level-order

8. Tree ki height ke baare mein kya sach hai?
a) root se sab se gehre node tak edges ki tadaad
b) root se sab se gehre node tak nodes ki tadaad
c) root node ke children ki tadaad
d) hamesha tree ke nodes ki tadaad ke barabar

9. Kaunsa graph traversal agle level par jane se pehle kisi vertex ke saare qareebi parosi dekhta hai?
a) Depth-First Search (DFS)
b) Breadth-First Search (BFS)
c) Depth-Limited Search (DLS)
d) Iterative Deepening Search (IDS)

10. Graph data structure kis soorat ke liye sab se munasib hai?
a) to-do list sambhalna
b) dukaan mein gahakon ki line ka model
c) social network ke rabte dikhana

blocks.caption: Multiple choice ke jawab
rows: (a) root se gehre node tak edges

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke aakhir mein (PDF 226) Unit 4 ki answer key c, c, b, c, c, b, d, c, c, a hai. Is mein sirf sawal 2, 3 aur 5 chapter ke matan se milte hain; baqi saat ghalat hain. Upar matan ke mutabiq sahi jawab hain. Sawal 10 mein kitab ne sirf teen options (a, b, c) chhape hain.

items: Python list mein extend() kaise kaam karta hai? Misal dein. (Hal: 4.1.1.3)
Jab do variables ek hi list ko reference karein to kya masail ho sakte hain? Misal dein. (Hal: 4.1.1.3)
Stack ki tareef kijiye aur LIFO usool samjhaiye. (Hal: 4.1.2)
Stack expression mein brackets ka balance check karne mein kaise madad deta hai? Tareeqa bataiye. (Hal: 4.1.3.4)
Queue ke Enqueue aur Dequeue operations mein farq bataiye. (Hal: 4.1.4.2)
Computer ke job scheduling system mein queue ka tasawwur kaise lagta hai? (Hal: 4.1.5.3)
Lists se doosre data structures kaise banaye ja sakte hain? (Hal: 4.1.1.4)
Depth-First Search (DFS) aur Breadth-First Search (BFS) mein farq bataiye. (Hal: 4.3.3)
Python lists ki dynamic size wali property bataiye; yeh lists ko lachakdar kaise banati hai? (Hal: 4.1.1.2)
Project ki task list ka Python program: tasks = [design, development, testing, deployment] par aath operations. (Hal: 4.1.1.3)
Do asal zindagi ki misalein jahan stack istemal hota hai, aur un mein stack ke operations. (Hal: 4.1.3.5)
(5 + 2) * (3 - 1) ko stack se postfix banayein aur har token ke baad stack aur output dikhayein. (Hal: 4.1.3.1)
Print jobs ki queue ka Python code: banana, teen jobs jorna, aage wala dekhna, nikalna, ek aur jorna, nayi queue dikhana. (Hal: 4.1.4.2)
In-order, pre-order aur post-order traversals misal ke saath. (Hal: 4.1.7.1)
Diye gaye graph (A se B, C, D; B se E, F; C se G; D se H, I) mein A se (a) DFS aur (b) BFS ki tarteeb. (Hal: 4.3.2 aur 4.3.3)
Mez tarteeb dene mein stack aur queue dono ka istemal. (Hal: 4.3)
